title: Make-Ahead Hot Buttered Rum Mix
description: For impromptu potions of hot buttered rum. this make-ahead mixture with brown sugar, butter, orange peel and apple pie spice is in the fridge and ready when you are. You can substitute 1/2 cup hot strong coffee or tea for the rum and boiling water.
ingredients: 0.25 teaspoon finely grated fresh orange peel

steps.text: Mix the brown sugar together with the butter and orange peel in a mixing bowl until evenly blended. Use immediately, or cover and refrigerate for up to 1 month.
To make 1 serving, place 1 rounded tablespoon of the brown sugar mixture into a mug. Add the rum and boiling water, and stir until the mixture is completely dissolved.
